data.name: BackgroundText
data.DebugDisplay:
Founded in 1970, Paris Saint-Germain are a professional French club currently playing in the Ligue 1 Uber Eats. Le PSG rather memorably tasted Ligue 1 Uber Eats title glory in 2023. They are the most successful club in the history of the Ligue 1 Uber Eats, French Cup and Trophée des Champions, a reflection of their historic success.

The club play their home games at Parc des Princes and possess state of the art training and youth facilities. The club's training ground is Campus Paris-Saint-Germain. The Paris SG reserve team play at Stade Georges Lefèvre whilst the youth team play at Stade Georges Lefèvre (terrain n°5). The club also has excellent academy coaching and an excellent youth recruitment network. The club is affectionately known as Le PSG and retains a fierce rivalry with Olympique de Marseille.

Having enjoyed their greatest era in the 2010s, Le PSG are undoubtedly one of the most successful clubs in France. Boasting a proud total of fifty-one competition wins, here are just some of their highlights: Paris SG finished runners-up in the UEFA Champions League in 2020, won the Cup Winners Cup in 1996 and finished runners-up once, won the French top division eleven times and are eight-time runners-up, and finished runners-up in the UEFA Super Cup in 1996."
